quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #10
										  					
  

37 Questions • Passing Score 32

questions.question: You see a railroad crossing with a crossbuck sign but no gates or flashing lights. What should you do?

options.text: Approach carefully and cross only when you are sure no train is coming.
Lower your radio volume to listen for a train.
Wait for a flagger to signal you before crossing.

questions.explanation: Always approach railroad crossings with caution. Cross only when you know no train is coming from either direction. If a flagger is present, follow their instructions.

questions.question: How often should you check your mirrors while driving?
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors about every 10 seconds to see if a vehicle is following too closely. Keep your eyes on the road. The car ahead of you could stop suddenly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What should you do when driving on slippery roads?

options.text: Drive as you would on dry roads.
Increase the distance between you and the car ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Increase the distance between you and the car ahead.
questions.explanation: On slippery roads, increase your following distance. Your vehicle needs more time to stop than it would on dry roads.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What colors are used for warning signs about upcoming hazards?

options.text: Black letters or symbols on a white background
Black letters or symbols on a yellow background
White letters or symbols on a blue background
White letters or symbols on a green background

questions.correctAnswerText: Black letters or symbols on a yellow background
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black letters or symbols. Work zone warning signs are orange with black letters or symbols.

questions.question: When you leave your vehicle unattended, you must:

options.text: Lock the ignition and remove the key.

questions.explanation: When leaving your vehicle unattended, turn off the engine, lock the ignition, remove the key, and set the parking brake.

questions.question: Two drivers arrive at a four-way stop at the same time. Who has the right-of-way?

options.text: One driver may continue driving without stopping.
One driver should honk to show they are giving up the right-of-way.

questions.explanation: At a four-way stop, if both drivers arrive at the same time, yield to the driver on your right. You can proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: Lanes of traffic moving in the same direction are divided by ____ lines.
questions.explanation: White lines separate lanes traveling in the same direction. Broken white lines can be crossed to pass. Solid white lines mark the right edge of the road. Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions.

questions.question: What should you be most concerned about when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights may be misaligned because one side of your car is higher than the other.
You could damage a tire by drifting onto the shoulder.
You could hydroplane if there is water on the shoulder.
You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road ahead. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not slam on the brakes or steer sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: You may drive across a dashed white line:

options.text: When it is safe to change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: When it is safe to change lanes.
questions.explanation: Dashed white lines separate traffic lanes moving in the same direction. You may cross dashed lines to pass, but only when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: Orange signs are:
questions.explanation: Work zone signs are orange and diamond-shaped with black letters or symbols. They warn you that workers are on or near the highway.

questions.question: Crossbuck signs indicate:
questions.explanation: Crossbuck signs mark railroad crossings. They tell you to yield to trains. Do not try to drive across the tracks faster than a train.

questions.question: When two vehicles reach an intersection at the same time with no signs or signals, which one has the right-of-way?

options.text: The vehicle approaching from the right.
The vehicle approaching from the left.
The vehicle whose driver sounds the horn first.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle approaching from the right.
questions.explanation: At an intersection with no traffic control device, yield to any vehicle coming from your right.

questions.question: You want to back out of your driveway and see children playing nearby. Before you move your car, you should:

options.text: Rev your engine to warn the children that you are moving.
Sound your horn so the children will hear you.
Walk to the back of your car to check that the way is clear.
Tell the children to stay away from the driveway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Walk to the back of your car to check that the way is clear.
questions.explanation: Always look out your back window when backing up. Do not rely only on your mirrors, especially when children are nearby. Get out and check behind your vehicle before backing into or out of a driveway.

questions.question: When approaching an accident scene, you should:

options.text: Keep your attention on your driving.
Stop if you are involved or if emergency help has not yet arrived.

questions.explanation: Only stop at an accident scene if you are involved or if emergency help has not arrived. Keep your focus on your driving and keep moving. Watch for people on or near the road. Do not stop just to look at an accident, fire, or other emergency.

questions.question: If you experience a tire blowout:

options.text: Take your foot off the gas.
Do not immediately use your brakes.
Gradually slow down and pull off the side of the road.

questions.explanation: If you have a tire blowout, take your foot off the gas pedal. Do not brake immediately. Gradually slow down and gently apply the brakes, then pull off the side of the road.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Always slow down at railroad crossings. Trains cannot yield to cars, so you must let them pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What should you adjust first when you get into a car to drive?
questions.explanation: Adjust your seat first so you are comfortable and can see the road clearly. Then adjust your mirrors and steering wheel based on your seat position.

questions.question: In winter weather, drivers should allow for at least ____ the normal stopping distance.
questions.explanation: Snow and ice make roads slippery and increase the risk of skidding. Allow at least three times the normal stopping distance to slow down safely.

questions.question: Many crashes are caused by:

options.text: Drivers traveling too fast for road conditions.
Drivers checking their mirrors and blind spots.
Drivers keeping a four-second following distance.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers traveling too fast for road conditions.
questions.explanation: Many crashes happen when drivers go too fast for the conditions. Always drive at or below the speed limit and slow down when conditions are poor.

questions.question: You should be careful when passing a bicycle because:

options.text: You are moving faster than the bicycle.
The bicycle always has the right-of-way.
Oncoming traffic may not see you pull out to pass.
The cyclist may swerve into traffic to avoid something on the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: The cyclist may swerve into traffic to avoid something on the road.
questions.explanation: Be careful when passing bicycles because the cyclist may suddenly swerve into traffic to avoid an object. Always drive slowly and carefully near cyclists.

questions.question: Which of these affects how alcohol impacts your body?

options.text: How much food is in your stomach
How much time passes between drinks

questions.explanation: Your blood alcohol level depends on how much you drink, how much time passes between drinks, and your weight. Food can slow alcohol absorption, but it cannot prevent intoxication if you drink too much.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead will turn sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question:
If you get seven points on your driver license, what may happen?
    I. You must file proof of financial responsibility.
    II. You can remove three points by completing a driver improvement class.
questions.explanation: If you get seven points, you may be required to take a driver improvement class for a $65 fee. When you complete the class, three points are removed from your record.

questions.question: What does an orange-colored sign mean?

options.text: The start of a no passing zone.

questions.explanation: Orange signs with black symbols warn of construction, maintenance, and emergency work.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Circular signs show railroad crossings. This sign tells you a train crossing is ahead and you should watch for trains.

questions.question: Your power steering stops working while driving. You should:

options.text: Honk your horn and turn off the ignition.
Turn on your hazard lights and brace yourself.
Steer with extra effort, slow down, drive to a safe area, and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steer with extra effort, slow down, drive to a safe area, and stop.
questions.explanation: If power steering stops working, you will need to use extra force to steer. Reduce your speed and carefully drive to a safe place to stop.

questions.question: When driving through an area where children are playing, what should you expect?

options.text: They will know when it is safe to cross the street.
They will stop at the curb before crossing the street.
They will run out in front of you without looking.
They will not cross the street unless with an adult.

questions.correctAnswerText: They will run out in front of you without looking.
questions.explanation: Always slow down and be extra careful when children are nearby. Children may not understand danger and could run into the street without looking first.

questions.question: If a driver is worried, nervous, angry, or crying, they should:

options.text: Drive normally, as emotions do not affect driving.
Drive faster because they are more alert.
Calm down and focus before starting the car.
Call a friend to talk while driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Calm down and focus before starting the car.
questions.explanation: Strong emotions make it hard to drive safely. When you are upset, your mind is not on driving. Always calm down and focus before you start driving.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead has one-way traffic only.
Only one car can cross the bridge at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the bridge ahead is narrow. You may not be able to safely pass a truck on this bridge. Drive carefully.

questions.question: If you refuse a chemical test when asked by a police officer, the DMV will:

options.text: Require you to take a safety class.

questions.explanation: If you refuse a chemical test, your driver license will be cancelled right away for at least 30 days. The DMV will also cancel it again for at least 12 months.

questions.question: This sign shows:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a road crossing ahead. An intersection is where two roads meet.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert you to dangers ahead. This sign means a steep hill is coming. Be ready to change your speed to stay safe.

questions.question: What helps drivers save gasoline?

options.text: Running the car while sitting in the driveway.

questions.explanation: Every time you brake suddenly, you use extra fuel to speed back up. If you look ahead and slow down gradually or change lanes to avoid hard braking, you will use less gas.
